Duration: 30 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Three timed shots, one continuous location. Mode: omni_reference.

Reference plan: Image 1 is Theo's identity and costume reference. Image 2 is Milo's identity and costume reference. Image 3 is the living-room environment reference. Image 4 is the star-blanket prop reference. Use the attached voice references for Theo and Milo; ignore the black frames.

Spatial blocking: The camera sits inside a suburban living room facing an open front doorway in the background. Theo enters from that doorway and settles in the midground left. Milo follows and settles in the midground right. After they enter they never swap sides: Theo stays screen-left, Milo stays screen-right, and neither crosses the central vertical axis. A long amber rectangle of low sunlight lies across the floor in the foreground between camera and the boys.

Theo anchor: The boy from Image 1, small for eight, warm brown skin, tight black cropped curls, faded mustard t-shirt with a washed-out rocket print, dark green shorts, mismatched socks, no shoes. His face, hair, costume, body proportions and silhouette remain identical throughout. He starts animated, talking with one hand raised, and ends standing still with his mouth closed. His bare feet stay planted on the hardwood.

Milo anchor: The boy from Image 2, taller, pale, freckled, straight sandy hair falling over his eyes, blue hoodie with the sleeves pulled over his hands, jeans, red sneakers, small grey backpack on his back. His face, hair, costume, backpack, body proportions and silhouette remain identical throughout. The backpack stays on for the entire block.

Shot 1 (0-10s): Wide, locked off, eye level. The front door swings open. Theo stands in the doorway backlit by the hallway, already mid-sentence, gesturing with one hand. Milo stands on the mat just outside with his backpack on. Theo says at 1 second: "Okay so I have four ideas and one of them is really good."

Shot 2 (10-20s): Medium two-shot, very slow dolly in. Milo steps past Theo into the room, stops, and his eyes travel down and across the floor. Theo watches him look. Neither speaks.

Shot 3 (20-30s): Wide, static. Both boys stand small in frame at the near edge of a rug buried in board-game boxes. Milo says at 24 seconds: "Which one's the good one?" Theo turns his head toward Milo, opens his mouth, and closes it again without speaking.

Camera: 35mm, eye level throughout. One slow controlled dolly-in during shot 2, locked off otherwise, always preserving Theo screen-left and Milo screen-right. Deep enough focus that the room reads.

Environment: a lived-in suburban living room in late afternoon. Low west sun through a window throws a long amber stripe across the floor. A worn teal couch with a navy star-printed fleece blanket folded over its back. A rug buried in board games, half the boxes unopened. Dust drifting in the light.

Continuity: Theo remains screen-left and Milo screen-right after entering. Costumes, hair, silhouettes and the grey backpack stay identical throughout. The star-blanket stays folded over the back of the teal couch and is clearly visible in the final frame.

Audio: quiet suburban room tone, a door handle and door swing at 0 seconds, sneakers on hardwood at 11 seconds, and the two spoken lines at their marked times. Output only the spoken dialogue and the scene's diegetic sound. No music.

Final frame: Wide and held. Theo screen-left and Milo screen-right stand side by side at the near edge of the game-covered rug, both facing away from camera into the room, mouths closed. The amber sun stripe lies across the floor in front of them and the navy star-printed blanket is clearly visible folded over the teal couch behind them.

shots.camera: Medium two-shot, low eye level, static
shots.action: They sit down among the boxes. Theo lifts a lid, looks inside, puts it back exactly where it was.
shots.dialogue: THEO: We could do this one. Or — that one's missing pieces.

shots.camera: Close-up on Milo's hands, then tilt to his face
shots.action: Milo picks up a small plastic dinosaur, turns it once, and sets it down in exactly the same spot.
Neither boy answers. Dust turns over in the shaft of light. They just sit in it.

blocks.final_frame: Wide, held and still: both boys seated cross-legged among the board games, Theo screen-left, Milo screen-right, shoulders down, nobody speaking. Theo's eyes have begun to drift screen-left toward the teal couch and the star-blanket folded over its back, which is clearly visible and well lit.

blocks.prompt:
Duration: 30 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. Three timed shots, one continuous move from inside the fort back out into the room. Mode: omni_reference.

Reference plan: The start frame is the final frame of the previous block and sets the exact opening composition — the two boys crouched at the mouth of the finished blanket fort. Image 1 is Theo's identity and costume reference. Image 2 is Milo's identity and costume reference. Image 3 is the fort-interior environment reference and controls what the ceiling looks like: the printed stars have become real starfield and drifting nebula. Image 4 is the star-blanket prop reference. Use the attached voice reference for Milo; ignore the black frames.

Spatial blocking: The camera moves inside the fort with the boys and settles low, near the floor, looking up. Theo lies screen-left and Milo lies screen-right, shoulder to shoulder on their backs, heads toward camera. They stay on those sides and do not swap. Above them is the blanket ceiling. At the end the camera retreats back out through the mouth of the fort in one unbroken move.

Theo anchor: The boy from Image 1 keeps the same face, tight black cropped curls, faded mustard rocket t-shirt, dark green shorts, mismatched socks, bare feet, body proportions and silhouette. He lies flat on his back and stays still, eyes open and upward, mouth closed. He does not speak in this block.

Milo anchor: The boy from Image 2 keeps the same face, straight sandy hair over his eyes, blue hoodie, jeans, red sneakers, body proportions and silhouette. No backpack. He lies flat on his back and stays still, eyes open and upward. He speaks exactly one line.

Shot 1 (0-10s): Low angle from inside the fort, looking up past their faces as they crawl in and lie back shoulder to shoulder. Warm amber light from the room outside is still leaking in low along the floor behind their heads. Both go still.

Shot 2 (10-22s): Slow tilt up from their faces to what they are looking at. The blanket ceiling is no longer a blanket: real black depth, real starlight, and a slow violet and teal nebula drifting past a narrow gap between two cushions that reads as a viewport. Neither boy moves. Nobody speaks. Hold on the sky.

Shot 3 (22-30s): One continuous slow crane back, retreating out through the mouth of the fort without a cut. Milo says at 23 seconds: "That's the good one." As the camera withdraws, the fort resolves into a small blanket fort glowing faintly from within, sitting in an ordinary living room in the last of the afternoon.

Camera: 35mm, low angle, slow and motivated throughout. Shot 3 is a single unbroken retreating crane — no cut, no whip, no snap zoom. It comes to a complete rest before the block ends.

Environment: inside, the fort interior from Image 3 — cushion walls, a ceiling of genuine deep space, a viewport gap, and warm amber floor spill at the very bottom of frame so it never stops being a living room. Outside, at the end, the same lived-in living room with board games still scattered on the rug and the last low sun across the floor.

Continuity: Theo remains screen-left and Milo screen-right, both lying on their backs, for the whole block. Costumes, hair and silhouettes stay identical to the start frame. The blanket keeps its navy colour and pale-yellow star pattern where it is still readable as fabric at the fort's edges.

Audio: very quiet close room tone inside the fabric, two sets of breathing, a soft fleece rustle at 3 seconds, and Milo's single spoken line at 23 seconds. A long held silence from 10 to 22 seconds with only breathing. Output only the spoken dialogue and the scene's diegetic sound. No music.

Final frame: Wide and held. The blanket fort sits small in the middle of the ordinary living room, glowing faintly from within, board games still scattered on the rug around it, the last warm amber light low across the floor. No people visible. The camera is at rest.
